report_topic: Management of Storm Water in Bengaluru Urban Area
observations_summary: The audit revealed significant deficiencies in storm water management in Bengaluru, including large-scale encroachment of lakes and drains, depletion of natural drainage systems, and rampant mixing of sewage with storm water. Poor planning, execution, and financial controls, along with a lack of comprehensive policies and maintenance, contributed to frequent flooding and environmental degradation.
